She has also trained extensively in theatre and founded Rhiyasat, a luxury handcrafted apparel label supporting Indian artisans.

Patients reported breathlessness and vision loss, with officials warning of kidney complications.  The liquor was manufactured and sold locally in Bhavnagar, and suspects have been detained.

This year, Taiwanese competitors celebrated a landmark achievement, claiming twenty-four gold medals and numerous honors, showcasing their ingenuity and practical solutions that captivated both judges and audiences.
